title: Account Executive - Marketing Solutions
description:
São Paulo/SP - Brazil

SiiLA is the dominant authority in commercial real estate news, data, and analysis across Latin America. Since our founding in 2015, we have built a reputation for delivering precise, reliable market intelligence with a relentless commitment to quality and integrity.

Powered by cutting-edge technology, SiiLA transforms raw data into actionable insights through subscription-based solutions trusted by the world's top commercial real estate professionals. Our platform offers unparalleled transparency, empowering clients to make informed decisions in a rapidly evolving industry.

Visit our website: siila.com.br

About the Role:

Are you passionate about commercial real estate, technology, and helping others succeed? SiiLA is looking for an Account Executive who combines business acumen with a consultative approach to selling.

This is not just a sales role—it's an opportunity to join a dynamic, fast-growing organization where your efforts will directly influence our continued success. We're looking for someone who is eager to become an expert in our products, understands the nuances of the commercial real estate industry, and embraces the challenge of developing long-term client relationships.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop a deep understanding of SiiLA's products, data, and the commercial real estate market to build credibility and be a trusted advisor to clients.
  • Understand the Platform's Advertising Features: Gain a deep knowledge of the platform's advertising offerings, tools, and capabilities to effectively showcase the benefits to potential clients and maximize their value.
  • Strategize Advertising Solutions: Work closely with the marketing team to design customized advertising solutions for clients, utilizing platform features to target the right audience and enhance commercial real estate market visibility.
  • Client Consultation & Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor by understanding clients' needs and leveraging the platform's advertising tools to achieve their business objectives, particularly in the commercial real estate sector.
  • Actively identify and qualify new business opportunities, leveraging a consultative selling approach to tailor solutions to client needs.
  • Engage with prospects through persistent outreach, effective listening, and thoughtful presentations to communicate SiiLA's value proposition.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting: Continuously monitor the performance of advertising campaigns on the platform, providing clients with insights and recommendations to optimize their campaigns.
  • Educate Clients on the Platform's Value: Conduct presentations, training sessions, and workshops to educate clients on effectively using the platform's advertising features, fostering long-term client relationships and engagement.
  • Collaborate with Product Development: Provide feedback to the product development team regarding client needs and industry trends, helping to refine and enhance the platform's advertising benefits for greater market relevance.
  • Drive Client Acquisition & Retention: Proactively identify opportunities to acquire new clients and retain existing ones by showcasing the unique advantages and results that the platform's advertising solutions deliver within the commercial real estate market.
  • Stay Current with Industry Trends: Keep updated with digital advertising and commercial real estate trends to ensure the platform remains competitive and aligned with market demands.
  • Take initiative to experiment, refine processes, and share ideas to help SiiLA scale in the Brazil Market and beyond.
  • Build strong relationships with prospects, clients, and industry stakeholders, maintaining trust and delivering value.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and exceptional client experiences.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

· Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, or a related field.

· A minimum of three years of experience in Marketing sales, preferably within commercial real estate, technology, or a related industry.

· Strong business sense with the ability to qualify prospects effectively and identify opportunities for tailored solutions in Marketing.

· A natural curiosity and willingness to dive into data, technology, and market trends to build expertise and credibility.

· Entrepreneurial mindset with a drive to contribute to the growth of a fast-evolving organization and make a measurable impact.

· Excellent interpersonal skills and clear, effective communication in both English and Portuguese.

· Persistence and resilience in handling objections, with the ability to bounce back and stay motivated.

· Strong organizational skills to manage multiple priorities, stay on top of leads, and deliver results.

· Confidence and presence to engage with executives while remaining personable and approachable.

· Coachable and adaptable, with a continuous improvement mindset and the ability to apply feedback effectively.

Follow us: @siila.br

title: Assistente de Visual Merchandising - Shopping Metrô Tucuruvi
description:

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, é apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes.

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória!

SOBRE A CENTAURO

A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.

Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo!

O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quando chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. E se você precisar de ajuda, saiba que nosso time #jogaentrosado, afinal, aqui #miramosotopo.

Muito mais que uma loja, a Centauro é um lugar de histórias escritas por vencedores. Vem fazer seu nome, vem fazer parte do nosso #TimeDeCampeões!

title: Engenheiro de controle
description:
About Woodgrove

We are a leading provider of energy efficient, innovative equipment, instrumentation, and process control systems to the global mining industry. With companies in Brazil, Chile, Mexico, and South Africa, Woodgrove has built a reputation based on quality, performance, and safety. The company is entrepreneurial, dynamic and our team are driven to succeed. We are looking for like-minded individuals that want to be part of a transformational business.

Role Summary

This role is for a position within the Advanced Process Control (APC) department. The APC department works with mine sites around the world (both remotely and on site) to deploy and integrate optimization solutions for the benefit of clients and industry. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys travelling and has an analytical mind.

All resumes must be in english.

Responsibilities

  • Development, deployment, and integration of Advanced Regulatory Control applications
  • Support deployment and integration of Expert Systems
  • Analyze and troubleshoot control system issues and provide solutions to improve system performance and reliability.
  • Experience commissioning and tuning of control systems.
  • Produce technical documentation (e.g., reports, manuals, specifications, drawings)
  • Conduct data analyses.
  • Verification and validation of software through inspection, simulation, and testing
  • Work with cross-functional teams to develop and implement control systems for new projects.
  • Perform regular reviews and upgrades on existing control systems to ensure optimal performance.
  • Ensure compliance with safety regulations and industry standards.

Qualifications/Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Control and Automation Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
  • English: intermediate, conversation level
  • Extensive experience in a control engineering project environment
  • Knowledge and axperience with multiple control systems, including PLCs, SCADA systems, and DCS systems (ABB, DeltaV, Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider, Honeywell, etc.)
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot control systems.
  • Proficiency with programming languages such as Ladder Logic, Function Block Diagram, and Structured text
  • Strong written, communication and interpersonal skills
  • Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to control systems.

title: Analista de Supply Chain Jr | Centro de Distribuição
description:
A Estrella Galicia

Somos uma empresa familiar, 100% independente desde 1906. Cultivamos o espírito artesano, mantendo vivos os valores inegociáveis e a paixão da Família Rivera. Nascemos na Galícia e chegamos até aqui sem perder as raízes, que se fortalecem há 5 gerações de cervejeiros. Somos artesanos e nossa arte é fazer cerveja a fogo lento, sem pressa.

Isso é Big Craft.

Nossa Cultura

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por 5 pilares:

Cuidado com as pessoas e nosso planeta: Valorizamos, desenvolvemos e reconhecemos nossas pessoas. Somos fortalecidos pela diversidade e respeitamos as pessoas do jeito que elas são.

Orientação para resultados: Somos engajados e comprometidos em atingir nossos resultados. Somos inconformados e obstinados na busca pela excelência. Conhecemos a nossa missão e pavimentamos nosso caminho com agilidade e proatividade, sem perder o foco.

Paixão pelo que somos e fazemos: Somos apaixonados pela nossa origem, história e cervejas. Superamos os desafios do dia-a-dia com entusiasmo e resiliência. Comemoramos e celebramos nossas conquistas e evolução.

Compromisso com nossos stakeholders: Geramos valor por meio de soluções inovadoras. Zelamos pelas nossas conexões, fortalecemos vínculos e desenvolvemos relações de benefício mútuo.

Integridade em nossas ações: Nossas decisões e condutas são orientadas pela ética, respeito e transparência. Atuamos de forma colaborativa e estamos aqui para fazer o que é correto, sem atalhos.

Em 2026, seguimos com todas as oportunidades como vagas intencionais para grupos minorizados.

Como será o seu dia a dia?

Você irá atuar no suporte administrativo e operacional do Centro de Distribuição, garantindo a conferência física e contábil dos produtos, a acuracidade de estoques, o correto processo de faturamento e a integridade das informações logísticas, contribuindo para a eficiência da operação e o cumprimento dos prazos.

O que esperamos de você?

Formação: Administração, Logística, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência prévia em Centro de Distribuição, logística ou operações de estoque;

Conhecimento básico de faturamento e documentação fiscal;

Excel intermediário;

Familiaridade com ERP (preferencialmente Datasul – Totvs);

Noções de CFOP, tipos de nota fiscal e fluxo de expedição;

Experiência com inventários e controle de estoque;

Vivência em operações logísticas de bens de consumo;

Conhecimento de indicadores de acuracidade e perdas.

Principais Responsabilidades

Conferência & Inventário

  • Realizar a conferência física e contábil de produtos no recebimento e na expedição, garantindo acuracidade;
  • Validar quantidades, lotes, códigos, avarias e documentação;
  • Executar inventários físicos, gerais e cíclicos;
  • Identificar e reportar divergências de estoque, apoiando ajustes conforme procedimento interno;

Faturamento & Documentação

  • Emitir e conferir notas fiscais de saída, conforme pedidos, rotas e clientes;
  • Validar CFOP (Código Fiscal de Operações e Prestações), volumes, pesos e informações fiscais básicas;
  • Apoiar o fluxo de expedição com liberação correta da documentação;
  • Organizar e arquivar documentos fiscais e operacionais, físicos e/ou digitais.

Rotina Administrativa do CD

  • Acompanhar entradas (inbound) e coletas (outbound) dos produtos.
  • Planejar as atividades diárias de carregamentos, distribuição e faturamento de produtos no CD.
  • Manter comunicação eficaz e integrar as equipes de operação do CD, clientes e parceiros, a fim de garantir o alinhamento de toda a cadeia.
  • Analisar processos operacionais para identificar oportunidades de melhoria, propondo e implementando ações para otimização de recursos.
  • Elaborar, monitorar e analisar indicadores de performance (KPIs) logísticos, como OTIF (On Time In Full) e acuracidade do inventário, entre outros.
  • Interface com áreas como Logística, Fiscal, Transporte e Comercial.
  • Seguir procedimentos internos e padrões de controle.

Qual será sua carga horária, modelo e local de trabalho?

  • Carga horária: 40 horas semanais
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Presencial
  • Local: Nova Iguaçu/RJ

Nossos benefícios

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico

Vale Alimentação/Refeição - Caju Benefícios (utilização em restaurantes e supermercados)

Wellhub/Gympass

Licença parentalidade

Seguro de Vida

Vale Transporte/Estacionamento

Convênio SESC

PPR de até 1 salário ao ano (sujeito ao atingimento de metas e proporcional ao tempo trabalhado)

Dia de Estrella (day off no mês de aniversário)

Ferramentas de trabalho:

  • Notebook
  • Celular (quando aplicável à posição)

Etapas Do Processo Seletivo (todas classificatórias)

Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve, caso esteja alinhado ao nosso perfil.

Entrevista com o RH: Este é o momento de nos conhecermos! Você terá um papo inicial com um representante do RH, com o objetivo de apresentar nossa cultura e o desafio que está sendo proposto e, ao mesmo tempo, apresentar a sua trajetória e momento profissional.

Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas habilidades técnicas! É também a oportunidade para você conhecer a estrutura, esclarecer possíveis dúvidas, aprofundar nos detalhes do desafio.

Entrevista com Pares: Nesta etapa você terá um papo com pares da liderança direta. Essas conversas nos ajudam a eliminar possíveis viéses. Também é uma oportunidade de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças e valores, nosso jeito de pensar e visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Seja qual for o resultado, todos os candidatos participantes do processo são comunicados sobre a evolução em cada etapa.

E aí? Curtiu? Então não deixe de se inscrever!

title: Product Designer
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product's end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.

Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.

Nice-to-haves:

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.

Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.

We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: Sales Manager-Motion Control & Industrial Automation-Brazil
description:
We are looking for a Regional Sales Manager based in Brazil, responsible for expanding our automation business across Brazil and the entire South American region.

This includes building strong relationships with distributors, system integrators, OEMs, and industrial end users in key markets such as Brazil, Chile, Argentina, Colombia, Peru, Ecuador, and others.

The ideal candidate understands LATAM's industrial automation market, has experience dealing with regional distributors, and can operate independently to scale our PLC, HMI, servo, and motion control business.

Responsibilities

1. Regional Business Development Across South America

  • Develop and manage business opportunities in Brazil, Chile, Argentina, Colombia, Peru, Ecuador, and other South American markets.
  • Establish strong relationships with industrial customers in key sectors:
  • Oil & Gas (offshore platforms, drilling systems, pump control, skid automation)
  • Mining (conveyors, crushers, hoisting systems, process automation)
  • Food Processing & Packaging (filling lines, bottling lines, labeling & sealing machines)
  • Robotics & Automation (robot OEMs, integrators, palletizing/packaging robots, AMRs/AGVs)
  • Identify automation upgrade projects, machine builder opportunities, and OEM/ODM potential.

2. Distributor & System Integrator Network Expansion

  • Recruit and evaluate partners in Brazil and across LATAM with strong technical capability and service teams.
  • Assess integrators serving the above industries (mining automation integrators, food packaging integrators, oilfield service SIs, robotics integrators).
  • Provide training on products, applications, and industry-specific solutions.
  • Jointly drive business opportunities, technical proposals, and commercial negotiations.
  • 3. Sales Management & Project Execution
  • Lead opportunity development from first contact to contract signing.
  • Prepare technical proposals, quotations, and commercial offers tailored to industry requirements.
  • Track project progress (pilot runs, commissioning, FAT/SAT), coordinating with China-based engineering teams.
  • Oversee regional pricing strategy, inventory planning, and distributor sales performance.
  • 4. Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis
  • Analyze competition in motion control and PLC/HMI markets (Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider, Omron, Delta, WEG, Bosch Rexroth).
  • Understand industry-specific requirements:
  • Oil & Gas → explosion protection, extreme environment reliability
  • Mining → heavy-duty servo/VFD, dust & vibration resistance
  • Food Packaging → high-speed motion control, hygiene requirements
  • Robotics → EtherCAT, CANopen, servo performance, safety functions
  • Provide structured feedback to HQ regarding product localization, certifications (INMETRO), and market gaps.
  • 5. Marketing, Events & Branding
  • Represent the company at major industrial exhibitions in LATAM (FEIMEC, FIEE, EXPOMAFE, EXPOMIN, Colombiatex, Expoagro).
  • Organize seminars, workshops, and roadshows with distributors.
  • Deploy demo units for partners and key customers across industries.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Automation, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or related technical fields.
  • 5–10 years sales or business development experience in one or more of the following sectors:
  • Oil & Gas (onshore/offshore automation)
  • Mining & heavy industry automation
  • Food processing & packaging machinery
  • Robotics, motion control, and industrial automation
  • Strong understanding of LATAM's industrial automation ecosystem (OEMs, integrators, distributors).
  • Proven track record managing regional distributors and large industrial accounts.

title: Accounting Analyst
description:
Teltonika aspires to become one of the global leaders in providing unique IoT solutions that contribute to making people's lives easier. Since 1998, we have gained considerable experience and competence in electronics development and production. Today, our areas of expertise include telematics, networking, telemedicine, EV charging, and electronics manufacturing. While proactively searching for new ideas and ways to create more value for our clients, we also hope to create a better future for our employees and the communities we operate in. Our organizational culture is based on mutual trust and respect as well as creating synergy with our employees and clients.

We are looking for an Accountant Analyst to join our team in São Paulo, Brazil. This role is ideal for a professional with strong accounting expertise, hands-on experience with local compliance, and the ability to work autonomously while collaborating with global stakeholders.

In this role, you will:

  • Prepare and manage the main financial statements (balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow).
  • Lead monthly and annual closings, including P&L reporting, in collaboration with the CFO
  • Maintain accurate general ledger records, journal entries, and supporting documentation
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian accounting, tax, and statutory requirements
  • Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable, including billing and reconciliations
  • Monitor cash flow and support foreign exchange operations
  • Support inventory control, monthly inventory audits, and reconciliation of assets and liabilities
  • Assist in budget preparation, financial forecasts, and variance analysis
  • Prepare financial reports for internal management and external stakeholders
  • Support internal and external audits
  • Contribute to process improvements related to accounting, importation, and financial controls

What we expect of you:

  • Good English skills (B1+, written and spoken)
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related field
  • At least 3 years of experience in accounting roles (mid-level or senior)
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian accounting and tax legislation
  • Experience with ERP systems and advanced Excel
  • High attention to detail, organization, and ownership mindset
  • Ability to work independently and manage deadlines
  • Nice to Have: Active CRC; Knowledge of financial routines such as cash flow, AP/AR, and budgeting; Experience in multinational or international environments; Familiarity with IFRS

What we offer:

  • Salary: We appreciate everyone's efforts and experiences, so we offer an attractive salary matching your skillset and field expertise.
  • Career: Great opportunities to grow in a strong and rapidly expanding company.
  • Work model: Hybrid (4 days in person and one remote)
  • Catering benefits: Cartão Caju (Vale Refeição of R$35 per working days + Saldo Livre of R$750 monthly + R$09 per working day), coffee and fruits provided in the office;
  • Health and Well-being Benefits: TotalPass, SESC membership, healthcare, dental care, and life insurance.
  • Teambuilding: regular office celebrations and events that help us to get to know each other better.
  • Caring and supportive team: we constantly seek for our employees to have better leadership while regularly sending our managers to external coaching sessions, conducting annual employee engagement surveys, and other management and HRD initiatives to help our employees overcome bottlenecks and challenges.

We will only contact selected candidates.

Você pode trabalhar de casa até 1 dia por semana e pode iniciar suas atividades entre 7h30 e 9h30 e encerrar entre 16h30 e 18h30, respectivamente.

Como estagiário(a) do nosso departamento de Recursos Humanos, você contribuirá para a nossa missão de construirmos juntos um futuro neutro em carbono todos os dias.

Quem somos

As nossas prioridades são as pessoas, a ética, a segurança e a sustentabilidade. Com a Tractebel, você pode ter um impacto positivo nos objetivos globais de neutralizar as emissões de carbono. O nosso maior ativo são os nossos empregados e a diversidade é a nossa força!

title: Railway Electrical Engineer
description:
Are you looking to grow in a company where you can become a partner? Our core values are the Customer, the Individual, and Professional Development. If this sounds like you, keep reading!

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking to hire a Railway Electrical Engineer to join our Rail team in Spain.

The selected candidate will be responsible for providing technical leadership in the design of airfields for large-scale international airport projects.

At IDOM, we offer you the opportunity to develop your professional career by actively participating in national and international projects that will challenge you to improve every day, in a collaborative and team-oriented environment. You will join a multidisciplinary group where you will play a key role in project development. You will gain a global perspective on different businesses and technologies in a flexible and trusting work environment.

If you join IDOM, you will find:

  • Flexible working hours
  • Teleworking 1 day a week or 2 afternoons
  • Intensive summer working hours (July and August)
  • Flexible remuneration (restaurant card, health insurance, transport card, childcare, etc.)
  • Life and accident insurance

  • Commitment to long-term professional careers
  • Access to home ownership for all
  • Multicultural and multidisciplinary environment
  • Favorable attitude towards delegation, beyond the usual
  • Mutual commitment
  • Interpersonal relationships that promote unity

ABOUT YOU

Don't hesitate to apply if...

  • You preferably have a degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • You have 5 years of proven experience in railway environments (high speed, metro, tram, etc.). Experience in railway electrification projects in both direct current (DC) and alternating current (AC) is also required, as well as experience in the design, review, and validation of grounding and equipotentiality schemes. The ability to work in multidisciplinary and international environments will be valued.
  • You have in-depth knowledge of stray currents and their mitigation.
  • You are proficient in key European regulations for the railway sector, including EN 50122 (electrical safety and grounding), EN 50121 (electromagnetic compatibility), EN 50119 (catenary), and are familiar with other relevant standards (IEC, EN, etc.).
  • You have the ability to analyze electrical risks, grounding systems, and stray currents, as well as to prepare technical reports, procedures, mitigation strategies, etc.
  • You are fluent in English (minimum level B2/C1) (spoken and written); other languages will be valued.
  • You are a team player, autonomous, flexible, technically rigorous, and internationally minded.
  • And above all... you are eager to learn in an international company like IDOM

ABOUT US

IDOM is an association of professionals whose activity focuses on carrying out engineering, architecture, and consulting projects that contribute to a more sustainable world. The people at IDOM are

connected by our work and by our ownership of the firm, and we cooperate to achieve our greatest professional and personal development and the best service for our clients.

That is why IDOM's core asset is the value and experience of its people. Highly qualified professionals with strong human qualities, deeply united, who work in an environment of respect for their professional identity and freedom, with a strong ambition for progress, development, service, and innovation.

Since our founding in 1957, we have grown steadily and are now a multidisciplinary, integrated, international organization with a presence in 130 countries, where more than 4,300 people carry out our professional activities.

Are you ready to take the next step?

If you join our TEAM, you will be able to develop your career at the highest level, in an environment of deep trust and professional respect.

If you share our philosophy and want to be part of our company, send us your CV.

We want to meet you!

title: TES - Trial Engagement Specialist
description:
Missão da posição:

Viabilizar a conexão pesquisadores e pacientes e patrocinadores através da pesquisa clínica.

Principais atribuições:

  • Promover o desenvolvimento técnico científico e operacional do estudo clínico patrocinado de acordo com as etapas e os objetivos estratégicos do projeto de pesquisa clínica conduzidos pela ODC;
  • Coletar e gerenciar as informações provenientes do campo para alinhamento junto aos envolvidos na gestão do projeto de pesquisa clínica, para adequada implementação das ações necessárias visando maior adaptabilidade às necessidades específicas apontadas ao longo do andamento do projeto com foco no resultado;
  • Mapear, planejar e executar ações de apoio à equipe do estudo clínico em todas as etapas do projeto;
  • Visitar e estabelecer relacionamento com Key Opinion Leaders, investigadores, médicos, coordenadores de estudo e profissionais de saúde relacionados a estudos clínicos e/ou áreas temáticas do projeto;
  • Promover e fornecer informação científica relativa ao projeto bem como identificar e delinear as necessidades e preferências do investigador e equipe;
  • Organizar e conduzir reuniões presenciais ou virtuais com investigador e equipe para treinamento e orientação do conteúdo técnico e científico do estudo clínico e de boas práticas clínicas sempre que pertinente;
  • Atuar como facilitador e colaborador entre a CRO e a equipe do investigador nas ações e atividades operacionais do estudo clínico;
  • Identificar e discutir a implementação de estratégias com investigadores e equipes com foco no apoio e melhoria do potencial de recrutamento de potenciais participantes no estudo clínico;
  • Mapear instituições, serviços, médicos, profissionais de saúde e organizações com elevado potencial para referenciamento de participantes com perfil para recrutamento no estudo clínico;
  • Organizar e conduzir reuniões presenciais ou virtuais com médicos especialistas e profissionais de saúde para promover o estudo clínico e estabelecer redes referenciamento de potenciais participantes com perfil para recrutamento no estudo clínico;
  • Participar em congressos e convenções para estabelecer e fortalecer relacionamento com KOLs, investigadores e especialistas com foco nos objetivos do projeto e potenciais novas ligações e captação de inteligência competitiva;
  • Cumprir os regulamentos, leis, procedimentos e sistema de garantia de qualidade.

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Formação completa na área da Saúde
  • Desejável Pós-Graduação na área da Saúde

Idioma:

  • Inglês intermediário
  • Desejável Espanhol

Tempo de experiência na função:

Mínimo de 1 ano de experiência nas áreas assistencial, acadêmica e de pesquisa clínica.

Experiência em visitação a profissionais de saúde, KOLs e especialistas, para promoção de conteúdos técnicos e científicos de doenças e terapias, estudos clínicos e/ou comercialização de produtos.

title: Gerente Soluções SAP
description:
A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.

Gerente Soluções – SAP

Local: Híbrido 2 vezes por semana em São Paulo (Capital).

Horário: 09:00 – 18:00.

Buscamos Gerente Soluções SAP Sênior, para integrar nosso time de pré-vendas. O profissional atuará em apoio direto à área comercial, definindo estratégias técnicas, coordenando entregas e garantindo propostas competitivas e aderentes às necessidades dos clientes.

Responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a equipe de vendas para identificar oportunidades e desenvolver estratégias SAP para os clientes;
  • Realizar apresentações técnicas e demonstrações de produtos para clientes potenciais, destacando benefícios e funcionalidades das soluções SAP;
  • Avaliar e compreender os requisitos SAP dos clientes e oferecer recomendações de soluções adequadas;
  • Colaborar com as equipes de engenharia e desenvolvimento para garantir que as soluções oferecidas atendam às necessidades dos clientes;
  • Elaborar custeio e precificação de soluções SAP, garantindo competitividade e adequação ao mercado;
  • Compreender e gerenciar o ciclo de venda, desde a identificação de oportunidades até o fechamento de contratos;
  • Desenvolver propostas técnicas e comerciais para empresas públicas e privadas, garantindo o cumprimento dos requisitos regulatórios e das especificações do cliente;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de propostas técnicas e documentos de resposta a RFPs/RFIs;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e tecnologias em SAP e disseminar conhecimento na equipe.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em SAP, preferencialmente com atuação em pré-venda;
  • Experiência em elaboração de propostas para empresas públicas e privadas;
  • Atuação comprovada como mandatário de delivery (responsável pela coordenação/entrega de projetos) ou Consultor SAP nas áreas logística (MM/SD/WM/Transportation) ou financeira (FI/CO), com forte conhecimento dos processos de negócio;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de integração de sistemas, gestão de dados e conformidade regulatória em ambientes SAP;
  • Experiência com provedores de nuvem/hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) em ambientes de nuvem pública;
  • Vivência com parceiros tecnológicos e integradores no mercado brasileiro;
  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia da Computação, Administração, Contabilidade, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas será diferencial;
  • Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita e conversação) — uso cotidiano;
  • Certificações relevantes em SAP serão consideradas diferencial;
  • Capacidade para trabalhar de forma autônoma e colaborativa;
  • Habilidade para comunicar conceitos técnicos de forma clara a públicos técnicos e executivos;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens conforme necessário.

Benefícios:

  • Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação;
  • Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos;
  • Plano odontológico;

  • Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa);
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas);
  • Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas);

Oportunidade para atuar com o time de Performance de Negócios, sendo esta área responsável por impulsionar resultados através da análise de dados. Suas atividades principais incluem o monitoramento contínuo de resultados, a proposição de ações estratégicas e a influência direta na melhoria contínua da performance do negócio.

Tendo objetivo a atuação em entregas de negócio, oferecendo ações que melhorem os resultados da companhia, utilizando análises de dados como base. A abrangência do cargo inclui a interlocução com equipes médicas, a tradução da visão estratégica/médica em dados e a interação executiva constante para a apresentação de propostas e resultados.

● Produzir análises inovadoras e escaláveis por meio de ferramentas de visualização e análise avançadas;

● Investigar e identificar padrões de sinistro incompatíveis com a conduta médica e as cláusulas contratuais;

● Identificar oportunidades de negócio, produzindo relatórios e apresentações executivas;

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor .NET Pleno/Sênior
description:

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Analista de Suprimentos Sênior - Categorias
description:
RESUMO DO CARGO

Sobre a Ardagh

A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. Globalmente, a AMP opera 24 instalações de produção nas Américas e Europa, empregando cerca de 5.800 funcionários e registrou receitas de US $ 4 bilhões em 2021. A inclusão, confiança, trabalho em equipe e excelência são nossos valores e junto com o talento que buscamos, serão a fórmula perfeita para crescermos juntos!

Somos apaixonados por sustentabilidade e temos uma ótima reputação pela inovação e qualidade que oferecemos a nossos clientes. Nós somos pioneiros em novos métodos de produção, novas técnicas de design e novas formas de reciclar e economizar energia. Nosso objetivo é reduzir os impactos ambientais, enquanto permanecemos economicamente sustentáveis e socialmente responsáveis.

Na Ardagh, temos a consciência da singularidade de cada ser humano. Valorizamos e respeitamos a diversidade da nossa rede de colaboradores. Se seu perfil corresponde à vaga, candidate-se a essa posição e #VEMserLateiroAMP.

description:

description:

Trabalhar de forma integrada com as áreas de negócio, comercial, produto, compliance, tecnologia e financeiro, com atuação consultiva, prática e orientada à solução.

description:

  • Conduzir mapeamentos e melhorias em processos;

title: Consultor de Importação | Santos/SP
description:
Sobre a China Link

A China Link é especializada em soluções completas para importação, atuando de forma estratégica para conectar empresas brasileiras a fornecedores e mercados internacionais.

Nosso trabalho é pautado em eficiência, segurança operacional e orientação consultiva, apoiando clientes em todas as etapas do processo de comércio exterior.

Buscamos profissionais que desejam atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com foco em relacionamento, estratégia e crescimento sustentável.

Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) de Importação para atuar de forma consultiva e estratégica, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de novos negócios, gestão da carteira de clientes e expansão de oportunidades relacionadas a serviços de importação.

A atuação envolve relacionamento comercial aliado ao conhecimento técnico em comércio exterior, apoiando clientes na tomada de decisão e na estruturação de operações de importação.

Escopo de atuação

O(a) profissional atuará de forma autônoma e consultiva, com foco em:

  • Desenvolvimento e gestão de relacionamentos com clientes, promovendo satisfação, fidelização e expansão de contas;
  • Identificação de novas oportunidades de negócios e prospecção de potenciais clientes;
  • Atendimento consultivo, compreendendo necessidades e propondo soluções em importação;
  • Elaboração de propostas comerciais e condução de negociações;
  • Acompanhamento de resultados e indicadores das contas sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Atuação integrada com áreas internas para alinhamento entre estratégia comercial e viabilidade operacional;
  • Colaboração com iniciativas comerciais e de marketing voltadas à geração de oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, importação e comércio exterior.

Requisitos

  • Formação ou experiência comprovada em Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia em atividades comerciais ou vendas consultivas;
  • Boa comunicação, capacidade de negociação e relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Organização, autonomia e foco em resultados;
  • Conhecimento em logística e processos de importação será considerado um diferencial.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com venda de serviços B2B;
  • Conhecimento em custos de importação, Incoterms e fluxo operacional;
  • Visão estratégica para desenvolvimento de negócios e expansão de carteira.

Modelo de atuação

  • Contratação no modelo Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)
  • Atuação presencial
  • Relação profissional baseada em entregas, responsabilidade técnica e parceria

Interessados(as) deverão se candidatar por meio do formulário de inscrição disponível em nossa página de carreiras:

Trabalhe Conosco - China Link

Acompanhe também nossos canais oficiais para ficar por dentro de novas oportunidades e demais vagas em aberto.

title: IT Network Engineer
description:
Experience background:

  • Solid knowledge of weak current engineering (Cabinet, UPS, Environmental Monitoring) and ability to supervise construction teams.
  • Experience in network engineering with complete project experience from 0 to 1 in building a headquarters integrated workplace (500+ people).
  • Familiar with the local ISP ecosystem in Brazil (Claro, Vivo, etc.) and has extensive experience in structured cabling acceptance.
  • Possessing a CCNA certificate or equivalent certification. Able to comprehend enterprise-level network architecture (Firewall, VPN, SD-WAN, Wireless) and has experience in local execution in Brazil
  • Familiar with low-voltage engineering systems and possesses strong project management experience, with a PMP certificate being preferable
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, IT-related fields, or Engineering.
  • Experience in IT network and data center system integration maintenance, with experience in Chinese enterprises preferred
  • Familiarity with enterprise-level network architecture and equipment management. Knowledge of routing protocols (Static, OSPF, BGP), VPN technologies (GRE, SSL, IPSec), and wireless protocols.
  • Proficiency in network and system monitoring tools (e.g., Zabbix, Grafana).
  • Experience in managing CCTV, access control systems, facial recognition devices, and UPS systems is preferred.
  • Familiarity with key brands of switches, wireless APs, cameras, racks, and cables.
  • Proven experience in implementing IT solutions, with the ability to optimize execution based on practical requirements.
  • Fluency in English is a must. Proficiency in either Mandarin or Portuguese is required.
  • Possession of relevant technical certifications (e.g., CCNA/CCNP) or project management certifications (e.g., PMP) is an advantage.

This is a role for builders, not order-takers. You'll own the entire sales cycle, work directly with US-based customers, and be rewarded on performance. If you believe sales is the fastest path to growth, autonomy, and income, this role is for you.

About Lilo

Lilo is rebuilding procurement for Commercial Real Estate using AI.

Hotels and CRE operators still manage procurement with emails, calls, spreadsheets, and tribal knowledge. Lilo replaces that chaos with a single AI-powered platform that automates purchasing, vendor management, invoice processing, and price optimization.

We work with major hotel management companies and staple hotel brands in the US, and we're in an explosive growth path. Top performers have outsized impact and ownership.

What You'll Do

  • Own the entire outbound sales motion: prospecting, discovery, demo, close with US-based customers
  • Represent Lilo at industry events and network your way to high profile decision makers
  • Build and manage a pipeline of C-level operators, hotel owners, and decision-makers
  • Navigate consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
  • Work closely with onboarding and product to ensure long-term customer success

What We're Looking For

  • Excellent written and spoken English (C2 level)
  • Up to 5 years of experience in B2B SaaS sales (closing role, not SDR-only)
  • Proven track record owning full sales cycles
  • Strong outbound prospecting skills (email, LinkedIn, calls)
  • Experience selling to US-based customers
  • Comfortable working remotely with high independence
  • Competitive, performance-driven mindset

Compensation & Upside

  • Base salary: US$2,500/Mo.
  • On Target Commission: $2,500+/Mo. (50/50 split)
  • Total OTE: $5,000+/Mo.
  • Uncapped commissions + boosters
  • ESOP package with high potential upside

The harder you grind, the more you make.

Who Should NOT Apply

This role is not for you if:

  • You are not confident selling in English to US customers
  • You want a passive, inbound-only sales role
  • You need heavy structure, scripts, or constant supervision
  • You're uncomfortable picking up the phone, doing outbound outreach, and rejection
  • You're looking for a slow-moving, corporate environment

Why Lilo?

  • Fully remote role with a fast-growing, US-based startup
  • USD compensation with uncapped upside
  • Direct exposure to high profile US-based customers
  • Fast-moving startup with real ownership and accountability
  • Early-stage opportunity with real revenue ownership and ESOP upside
  • Performance-first compensation with uncapped upside
  • Ambitious, low-ego, execution-focused team
  • Exposure to AI, SaaS, and hospitality at scale

title: Senior Key Account Manager
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

What You'll Do

  • Responsible for the development and operation of regional chain brands, driving user acquisition and scale growth for assigned brands, leading the team to execute the company's sales strategies, and achieving performance targets;
  • Promote deep collaboration between regional chain brands and the platform in areas such as brand marketing, promotional activities, and user operations, enhancing the partnership and stickiness between the brands and Keeta;
  • Based on the characteristics of the food and beverage industry, develop a deep understanding of categories and brand operation models, identify business development opportunities, and formulate tactical plans covering (but not limited to) growth, marketing, user experience, and membership programs to strengthen Keeta's influence within the industry;
  • Establish strong communication with the delivery department, acting as a bridge between brands and the platform's delivery operations, and work collaboratively to continuously optimize the brand delivery service experience;
  • Fully leverage personal work potential, gather frontline marketing information, user feedback, and local market dynamics to provide valuable insights and references for the company's decision-making.

What We Need From You

  • Solid experience in key account management, channel development, or retail management, with a solid foundation in management methodologies and practices.
  • Strong business negotiation and market expansion skills, with a keen ability to identify client and user needs and a proactive attitude toward challenges.
  • Experienced in process and project management, with the ability to drive multiple tasks and projects concurrently.
  • Highly reliable and resilient, demonstrating strong work enthusiasm and a collaborative team spirit.
  • Fluent in English (speaking, reading, and writing) and capable of using it as a working language; proficiency in Portuguese is a strong plus.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Principal Backend Engineer (Typescript)
description:
Description

We are seeking a highly skilled Principal Backend Engineer with deep expertise in Typescript and strong experience designing and evolving backend architectures. You will be expected to work with a high level of autonomy, driving technical decisions, defining best practices, and leading complex projects from design to deployment. This is not a managerial position, but you will act as a technical reference for the team, mentoring others and setting high standards for code quality, scalability, and DevOps practices.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and evolution of backend architectures, ensuring scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Define and implement engineering best practices and frameworks to uplift our quality and resiliency.
  • Take ownership of complex technical initiatives, from planning and estimation to delivery.
  • Collaborate with cross‐functional teams to integrate frontend and backend components seamlessly.
  • Guide and mentor other engineers, sharing knowledge and reviewing code to ensure technical excellence.
  • Champion CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and DevOps best practices.
  • Proactively identify areas for improvement in our systems and propose architectural changes.

Technology Requirements

  • 8+ years of professional experience as a backend developer.
  • Deep expertise in Typescript and NestJS, with solid knowledge of relational and non‐relational databases.
  • Hands‐on experience designing and deploying microservices and event‐driven systems.
  • 3+ years running workloads on AWS Lambda and related services (DynamoDB, RDS), with strong understanding of cloud architecture patterns.
  • Strong understanding of clean code principles, separation of concerns, and software design patterns.
  • Solid experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code and monitoring practices is a plus.
  • Experience with Python is a plus.

Profile Requirements

  • Ability to work independently and drive projects with minimal supervision.
  • Strong project management mindset and interpersonal skills.
  • A team player who enjoys collaborating and helping others grow.
  • Experience in frontend development is a plus.

description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

What You'll Do

  • Responsible for the development and operation of regional chain brands, driving user acquisition and scale growth for assigned brands, leading the team to execute the company's sales strategies, and achieving performance targets.
  • Promote deep collaboration between regional chain brands and the platform in areas such as brand marketing, promotional activities, and user operations, enhancing the partnership and stickiness between the brands and Keeta.
  • Based on the characteristics of the food and beverage industry, develop a deep understanding of categories and brand operation models, identify business development opportunities, and formulate tactical plans covering (but not limited to) growth, marketing, user experience, and membership programs to strengthen Keeta's influence within the industry.

What We Need From You

  • Have excellent business negotiation and market development capabilities, be loyal to business goals, have insight into the needs of users, and be brave to embrace challenges.
  • Have basic data analysis skills and master office software applications. Experience in working with charts/graphs is required.
  • Integrity, honesty and resilience. Passionate about work and possessing a strong team spirit.
  • English and Portuguese can be used as working languages.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Product Owner
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.

About This Opportunity

As a Product Owner, you will work closely with both our Business Intelligence and Reporting Teams. In this position you will be accountable to manage data and reporting requirements to fulfill stakeholder or customer requests. You will also lead the roadmap and requirements analysis primarily for our financial systems.

The ideal candidate will have experience with Scrum/ Agile processes, Accounting/Financial Systems, SSRS, PowerBI, and Tableau. Knowledge of ETL and Oracle/Oracle EBS is a plus.

Professional English Language skills are required.

Position is CLT and fully remote (must reside in Brazil). Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for Internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses!

Responsibilities

  • Work directly with Finance & Accounting leadership and BI teams on product backlog and coordinate with various technology teams across InComm to implement new solutions.
  • Build, manage and prioritize product backlog based on the overall strategy and business objectives for future product development.
  • Responsible for creating and/or managing following artifacts:

-Road Map

-Development Backlog

-User Stories and Sprint Tasks

-Supporting documents for user stories

  • Monitor and Review ServiceNow (SNOW) requests
  • Create product vision and roadmap which accomplishes the goal of the vision and convey that vision to the scrum team.
  • Ensure user stories are well defined and ready for development to begin.
  • Responsible for optimizing the value of the work done.
  • Accountable for each stage of the development process and the final product.
  • Ensure close collaboration with development team. Be available to address any questions team members have regarding requirements or implementation of a product feature.
  • Responsible for communicating with stakeholders across the board, including product managers, leadership, customers, and the development team to make sure their vision is aligned with business objectives.

Preferred Qualifications/Experience:

  • Experience with reporting and operations within Billing, Accounting, and Sales
  • Experience working in Agile/Technical environments
  • Skilled in and comfortable working alongside technical stakeholders, translating business needs into clear, actionable inputs for development or support teams.
  • Proficient in Agile/Scrum

  • General knowledge of ERP, Databases (Oracle & MS SQL) and DataLakesis a plus

title: Finance Manager (Brazil)
description:
The Finance Manager will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The role encompasses daily accounting operations, month-end and year-end closings, and statutory audits, while providing management with financial analysis, budgeting support, and strategic guidance. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements.
  • Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management.
  • Manage closing processes and preparation of accurate and timely financial reports and analysis of financial information.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and municipal tax obligations.
  • Manage tax incentives including PPB (Processo Produtivo Básico) and tax optimization opportunities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax laws.
  • Coordinate and liaise with external parties (e.g. banks, external auditors, tax agents, corporate secretarial agents, local tax and government authorities) to ensure smooth operations.
  • Collaborate across departments in preparing and managing the OPEX budgets.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in internal accounting and financial operations efficiency.
  • Partner with business units to provide finance-related advice.
  • Coordinate with headquarters to align local reporting with group consolidation requirements.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in finance and tax management, including 3+ years in an international setting.
  • Knowledge of Direct and Indirect tax.
  • Advanced analytical skills and high attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently, manage pressure, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Prior experience in accounting firms is an added advantage.

Por que essa vaga é única?

title: Cientista de Dados Sr (IA Generativa)
description:
A BR Media Group é um hub de conteúdo referência no mercado para a economia de criadores, tem mindset data-driven e lidera soluções de influência e conteúdo para as principais marcas do mundo.

Procuramos uma pessoa para atuar como Cientista de Dados SR e AI para compor nossa equipe de Dados e Inovação, atuando diretamente no coração de nossas operações de marketing de influência e no desenvolvimento de produtos que irão revolucionar o mercado.

Se você é apaixonado por dados, machine learning e IA Generativa, entende o potencial dessas tecnologias para transformar o mercado de mídias sociais e criadores de conteúdo, e tem um perfil proativo, analítico e orientado a resultados, queremos conhecer você!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Essa pessoa será responsável por liderar nosso roadmap de desenvolvimento de produtos internos de AI e ML:

  • Liderar e executar o roadmap estratégico de Data Science e AI, desenvolvendo produtos internos que irão revolucionar nossa operação e a forma como entregamos valor.
  • Atuar em todo o ciclo de vida dos projetos (end-to-end), desde a concepção e coleta de dados (Engenharia de Dados) até o deployment e monitoramento dos modelos (MLOps).
  • Desenvolver e implementar soluções de Inteligência Artificial Generativa (GenAI) para otimizar processos internos e criar novas ferramentas para criadores e marcas (ex: análise preditiva de conteúdo, assistentes de briefing, etc.).
  • Criar modelos de machine learning para resolver desafios de negócios, como: previsão de performance de campanhas, sistemas de recomendação de influenciadores (matchmaking), análise de sentimento em larga escala e detecção de tendências.
  • Projetar e gerenciar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT), garantindo a qualidade, disponibilidade e integração dos dados provenientes de diversas fontes (APIs de redes sociais, dados internos, etc.).
  • Colaborar diretamente com as equipes de Produto, Marketing e Operações para entender as necessidades de negócios e traduzi-las em soluções técnicas viáveis.
  • Analisar e extrair insights de grandes volumes de dados (estruturados e não estruturados) do ecossistema de mídias sociais.
  • Apresentar resultados e descobertas complexas de forma clara e acionável para stakeholders (lideranças e equipes não técnicas).

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de Data Science e Machine Learning, com um portfólio de projetos aplicados.
  • Proficiência em Python e suas principais bibliotecas de dados (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn).
  • Experiência prática com frameworks de Deep Learning (ex: TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de soluções com LLMs (Large Language Models), fine-tuning, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e ferramentas como LangChain ou similares.
  • Conhecimento sólido em SQL e experiência prática com bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais.
  • Experiência em engenharia de dados, construção de pipelines (ETL) e orquestração de jobs (ex: Airflow).
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita, com capacidade de "traduzir" o técnico para o negócio.
  • Perfil analítico, focado em resolução de problemas e orientado a resultados.
  • Experiência com plataformas de nuvem (GCP, AWS ou Azure) e suas ferramentas de AI/ML.

Diferenciais (Qualificações Desejáveis):

  • Experiência prévia em empresas do mercado Publicitário, MarTech ou Marketing de Influência.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de MLOps (ex: MLflow, Kubeflow) e deploy de modelos (ex: Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados (ex: Looker Studio, Power BI, Tableau).

title: Supervisor (a) Florestal - Proteção Florestal
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Principais Atividades:

  • Gerir pessoas, distribuindo tarefas, acompanhando desempenho e promovendo treinamentos contínuos;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas de segurança, conduta e procedimentos internos;
  • Elaborar e atualizar planos de prevenção de incêndios;
  • Coordenar brigadas em situações de emergência e definir estratégias de combate;

  • Utilizar sistemas de vigilância (câmeras, drones, aplicativos) para inspeções e controle das áreas;
  • Monitorar pragas, doenças e infraestrutura rural, apoiando ações de conservação ambiental;
  • Aproximar-se das comunidades vizinhas, apoiando demandas sociais e mediando conflitos;
  • Controlar checklists, manutenção e indicadores de frota, assegurando uso adequado dos equipamentos;
  • Gerir bases aéreas, equipes helitransportadas e contratos de empresas aéreas.
  • Planejar recursos financeiros, humanos e materiais, assegurando a melhor logística.
  • Acompanhar indicadores (KPI's), aprovar pagamentos e participar de auditorias, garantindo conformidade legal.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência comprovada em monitoramento, segurança patrimonial e combate a incêndios florestais;

title: SAP SD/MM Supervisor
description:
Main Responsabilities

We are looking for an experienced SAP SD/MM Supervisor to join our team in Brazil and play a critical role in supporting the business during the ongoing tax reform initiatives in the country, one of the most complex and transformative regulatory changes in the region.

This role was created to bring deep SAP SD/MM expertise in the Brazilian market, ensuring compliance, business continuity, and system evolution over the coming years, while also supporting LATAM/Mercosur operations and acting as a strong local IT presence, and will be responsible for:

  • Experience in SAP BASIS activities, including system upgrade and SAP OSS Notes applications.
  • Familiarity with SAP Notes discovery and implementation support
  • Deep Understanding of Brazil Tax Environment, particularly indirect taxation. Recent tax reform aims to simplify and modernize the tax system by replacing multiple existing taxes (IPI, PIS, COFINS, ICMS, ST and FCP) with two new taxes: CBS (Contribution on Goods and Services) and IBS (Tax on Goods and Services).
  • Working Expertise of Inbound and Outbound Brazil Nota Fiscal (SAP Electronic Invoicing) Processes and Requirements
  • Assess as-is processes and map them into new processes and/or business flows, leveraging SAP best practices.
  • Work closely with business teams, system integrators, and stakeholders to understand needs, identify options for, and recommend optimal solutions to optimize business processes.
  • Develop expertise and serve as an SME for process and data discussions, workshops, and analysis related to Sales and Distribution (SD) and Materials Management (MM) processes.
  • Produce high-quality documentation, including but not limited to current-state analysis, future-state processes, workflows, data mapping, decision matrices, use cases, testing scenarios, and full business requirements.
  • Collaborate with project teams and business partners during project planning, software delivery reviews, and testing to ensure the software has been implemented according to specifications.
  • Document "business problem" to be solved and complete current state analysis and lead requirements gathering exercises through discovery sessions.
  • Provide advice, troubleshooting, and guidance for end-user support; identify areas for automation of manual processes and data analytics reporting.
  • Conduct meetings and deliver presentations; gather critical information to produce useful reports.
  • Monitor deliverables and support the timely completion of projects.

Mandatory Requirements

  • SAP experience with a strong focus on SD and MM modules in Brazil.
  • Proven experience with Brazilian indirect taxes and electronic invoicing (NF-e).
  • Experience with Mastersaf E-Invoicing.
  • Solid understanding of SAP SD/MM integration with other modules.
  • Previous experience leading or supervising SAP functional resources (internal or external).
  • Strong communication skills, able to interact with business, regional, and global stakeholders.
  • Advanced English.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, MIS, Engineering, Business, or another related field.

Desired Qualities

  • Strong communication, collaboration, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to build relationships and engage effectively with different audiences.
  • Sense of ownership with a positive, can-do attitude.
  • Detail-oriented with excellent planning, organizational, and time management skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a cross-functional team.
  • Innovative problem-solving skills to streamline and automate business processes.

Job Location

Vila Mariana (São Paulo)

Work modality: Hybrid

Schedule: 08:00 a.m. to 05:00 p.m.

About Stepan

Founded in 1932, Stepan Company is a leading manufacturer of basic and intermediate chemicals, including surfactants, polymers, as well as specialty ingredients used in consumer, household, and institutional products such as laundry detergents, shampoos, and surface cleaners.

Stepan Company currently operates 20 global plants and employs more than 2,000 people. We have a strong track record of growth. Our growth allows us to offer significant career opportunities and stability to our team members. We have ambitious goals at Stepan and know that every team member will be crucial in achieving them. Regardless of the role, we look for team members who bring a growth mindset, an entrepreneurial spirit, and the ability to thrive in an evolving environment.

We celebrate diversity at Stepan and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, genetic information, disability, age, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

title: Java Fullstack Developer (Angular)
description:
About You

You are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You're motivated by clean architecture, modern technologies, and meaningful collaboration across backend and frontend layers. You're looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience developing backend solutions using Java (21+) and Spring Boot.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining monolithic backend applications following clean architecture principles.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
  • Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, CloudWatch, and Bedrock.
  • Experience using MyBatis as an ORM and Liquibase for database versioning and migrations.
